sloka: बहूनि रत्नानि आदाय राज्ञो दशरथस्य ह ।ततो वसिष्ठः सुप्रीतो राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-१३-३५॥
transliteration: bahūni ratnāni ādāya rājño daśarathasya ha ।tato vasiṣṭhaḥ suprīto rājānam idam abravīt ॥1-13-35॥

translations.english: O foremost of kings, you ought to see the sacrificial ground full of sources of entertainment arranged everywhere, as though improvised by imagination".
